statement: NVIDIA guided FY2028 revenue growth of approximately 70%, explicitly labeled supply-constrained, with Jensen Huang saying demand is much greater than 70% and that supply, not demand, is the limit.
why: A full-year growth guide set by what can be built rather than what can be sold means the reported number understates underlying demand and pins the bottleneck upstream.

impact.mechanism: Guidance capped by supply signals durable order demand while confirming that memory and packaging capacity, not customer appetite, sets shipment volumes.

evidence.source: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: Even though our demand is much greater than 70%, our supply allows us to confidently deliver 70%.

confidence.basis: Direct quotes but relayed by one secondary outlet; not read from an NVIDIA filing or transcript.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call), NVIDIA Newsroom
